# German address normalization (`DE_NormalizForAddress`, `und-t-und-x0-afillde`).
# Mirrors //components/autofill/core/browser/data_model/transliterator.cc.

# Apply DIN 5007-2 umlaut expansion before stripping nonspacing marks.
[ö {o\u0308} Ö {O\u0308}] → oe;
[ä {a\u0308} Ä {A\u0308}] → ae;
[ü {u\u0308} Ü {U\u0308}] → ue;

# Delegate the remaining NFD + nonspacing-mark removal + lowercase + NFC +
# Latin-ASCII pipeline to `NormalizeForAddress` (`und-t-und-x0-afill`).
::NormalizeForAddress;
